questions.markdown: Explain the construction and working of calomel electrode as both cathode and anode. Mention any two disadvantages of it.

i) Calculate EMF of the zinc-silver cell at 25$^c$ with $[\mathrm{Zn}^{2+}] = 3\ \mathrm{M}$ and $[\mathrm{Ag}^+] = 15\ \mathrm{M}$. Write the cell representation and electrode reactions.

ii) Justify: Aqueous electrolytes are not preferred in lithium ion batteries.

(3+1 = 4 marks)

Give reasons for the following:

i) Ambient air cannot be used in alkaline fuel cell.

ii) Pure chromium is not used as anode during chromium plating.

i) The concentration of yeast t-RNA in an aqueous solution is 10 M. The absorbance is found to be 0.209 when this solution is placed in a 1.00 cm cuvette and 258 nm radiations are passed through it.

 a) Calculate the specific absorptivity

 b) What will be the absorbance if the solution is 5 M?

ii) With relevant graphical representation explain the conductometric titration of weak acid vs strong base.

(2+2 = 4 marks)
Define reverse osmosis. Describe with a neat diagram how sea water is purified using this technique. Write any two advantages of it.

i) Define electrodialysis.

ii) Distinguish between hard water and soft water

i) Describe in detail the electrochemical theory of corrosion of iron.

ii) Why does a tin-coated iron rust rapidly when the tin layer is broken?

i) Explain the principle of sacrificial anode and impressed current methods of preventing corrosion.

ii) Explain the effect of the following factors on the rate of corrosion

a) Nature of metal

b) Temperature.
Write a brief note on i) Liquid metal corrosion ii) Galvanic corrosion

Explain the classification of the following.

i) Particle reinforced composites

ii) Thermotropic liquid crystals based on the shapes

Explain the preparation of the following.

i) Thin film by Vacuum deposition

ii) Nano materials by sol-gel method.

i) A polymer sample whose number average molecular weight is 11200 has the following composition.

Degree of polymerization 200 300 400 500
% Composition 10 20 30 40

Calculate the molecular weight of monomer and weight average molecular weight.

i) Write the reactions involved in the electroless plating of copper.

ii) The change in free energy($\Delta G$) for the cell Cd(s) /CdCl2(aq) //AgCl(s) /Ag at 298 K is -98.3 kJ/mol, the temperature coefficient of emf is -0.0129 V/K and the corresponding emf at 273 K is 0.8325 V. Calculate $\Delta H$ and $\Delta S$ at 273 K.

(i) Differentiate between:

a) CVD and PVD.

b) Nematic and smectic phases of liquid crystals.

ii) What is glass transition temperature? What is the influence of plasticizer on glass transition temperature?
Explain the intergranular corrosion observed in 18-8 stainless steel during welding.
